title: MCTS Is Counting the Wrong Thing: Learning Exploration Counts for LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.22301v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS) has powered landmark successes in reinforcement learning, yet its gains in LLM reasoning can remain modest despite substantial search effort. We identify an overlooked bottleneck: what MCTS counts. Standard UCT assigns independent visit counts to textual branches, allowing different formulations of the same reasoning strategy to repeatedly receive exploration bonuses. Our theoretical analysis shows that this count fragmentation can impair exploration efficiency, as quantified by increased cumulative regret. To address this problem, we introduce Learned Pseudo-Count MCTS (LPC-MCTS), which changes only the exploration statistic in UCT. A lightweight Coin-Flipping Network head on the policy's hidden representations estimates representation coverage, enabling related branches to share exploration evidence. translated_title: MCTS 在统计错误的东西：为 LLM 推理学习探索计数
translated_abstract: 蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）在强化学习中取得了里程碑式的成功，但其在 LLM 推理中的收益尽管投入了大量搜索计算，却可能仍然有限。我们识别出一个被忽视的瓶颈：MCTS 所统计的对象。标准 UCT 为文本分支分配独立的访问计数，使得同一推理策略的不同表述能够反复获得探索奖励。我们的理论分析表明，这种计数碎片化会损害探索效率，具体表现为累积遗憾的增加。为解决这一问题，我们提出了学习伪计数 MCTS（LPC-MCTS），它仅改变了 UCT 中的探索统计量。一个轻量级的“抛硬币网络”头基于策略的隐藏表示来估计表示覆盖率，使相关分支能够共享探索证据。在 5 个数学推理基准和 7 个搜索基准上，LPC-MCTS 持续优于强大的 MCTS 基线。
tldr: 论文发现 UCT 对同一推理策略的不同文本表述重复给予探索奖励导致计数碎片化、损害探索效率，并提出 LPC-MCTS，利用轻量级 Coin-Flipping Network 估计表示覆盖率作为探索伪计数，让相关分支共享探索证据，在数学推理与搜索基准上持续超越强 MCTS 基线。
en_tdlr: LPC-MCTS fixes MCTS's fragmented visit counts by replacing UCT's exploration statistic with learned pseudo-counts from a lightweight Coin-Flipping Network that estimates representation coverage, enabling related branches to share exploration evidence and consistently outperforming strong MCTS baselines across mathematical reasoning and search benchmarks.
